message.content: {"question":"For all t ∈ R, let us consider the points P = (2,2,2), Q = (0,0,t), R = (1,-1,t), S = (-3,2,1+t). Which of the following statements is true?","options":{"A":"The points P, Q, R, S are vertices of a trapezoid for all values of t.","B":"The points P, Q, R, S are coplanar when t = 7.","C":"The points P, Q, R, S are vertices of a rectangle for all values of t.","D":"The points P, Q, R, S are coplanar for at least one value of t ∈ R."},"correct":"D"}
